agencyName: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing (rule text mirrored by Cornell Law School's Legal Information Institute)
authorityRationale: Utah Administrative Code R156-1-302 (Licensure by Endorsement), the general DOPL-wide rule that Electricians Licensing Act Rule R156-55b-305 explicitly incorporates by reference for electricians. Utah's own rule-hosting sites (rules.utah.gov, adminrules.utah.gov, le.utah.gov) were unreachable or returned 404/connection-refused throughout this research, so this is cited via Cornell Law School's Legal Information Institute — a non-government, non-profit legal-text mirror, not the .gov original. Marked official:false / authoritative:supplementary for that reason; used only for non-critical fields (endorsementRules, requiredExams context), never for licensingBoard or reciprocityRules.
reliabilityRationale: Cornell LII is a widely-cited, verbatim (non-commentary) mirror of state regulatory text used by courts and legal researchers, but it is a third-party republication, not the primary government source itself — reliability capped below the project's typical .gov-sourced facts for that reason.
